claims: UFC Freedom 250 is scheduled for June 14, 2026.
UFC Freedom 250 is on the South Lawn of the White House.
UFC Freedom 250 features a main event between Ilia Topuria and Justin Gaethje for the lightweight title.
UFC Freedom 250 celebrates the USA's 250th anniversary.
UFC Freedom 250 main card includes a Lightweight Title Bout between Ilia Topuria and Justin Gaethje.
UFC Freedom 250 main card includes a Heavyweight Interim Title Bout between Alex Pereira and Ciryl Gane.
UFC Freedom 250 main card includes a Bantamweight Bout between Sean O'Malley and Aiemann Zahabi.
UFC Freedom 250 main card includes a Lightweight Bout between Mauricio Ruffy and Michael Chandler.
UFC Freedom 250 main card includes a Middleweight Bout between Bo Nickal and Kyle Daukaus.
UFC Freedom 250 main card includes a Featherweight Bout between Diego Lopes and Steve Garcia.
The location of UFC Freedom 250 is the White House South Lawn, Washington, D.C.
Weigh-ins for UFC Freedom 250 are held at the Lincoln Memorial.
The UFC is handling costs for UFC Freedom 250.
Estimated grass replacement for UFC Freedom 250 costs up to $1 million.
